## Abstract

We open the session by **discussing the entry texts** you read during the decentralized
working week. Each reading group reports on its text, and we compare the different
entry points into Ecological Economics with each other.

::: {.callout-important}
## Come prepared

Bring your answers to the guiding questions from
[Session 2](s_02_DecentralizedWeek.qmd) — in particular the one-sentence answer to:
*what was the most surprising or challenging idea your text presented?*
:::
